operators.name: Arp
operators.summary: Note effect: holds the keys you play and re-issues them as an arpeggio.

operators.name: BeatRepeat
operators.summary: Beat-synced slice repeater with per-repeat decay.

operators.name: Bitcrush
operators.summary: Bit-depth + sample-rate reduction (lo-fi crush).

operators.name: Blur
operators.summary: Box blur of the input texture; radius is wire-drivable.

operators.name: Composite
operators.summary: Blend two inputs (A base, B over): normal/add/multiply/screen/overlay.

params.description: How B is blended over A
params.name: mode

operators.name: CRT
operators.summary: Broadcast/CRT treatment: barrel curve, scanlines, RGB shadow-mask, aberration, vignette, roll.

operators.name: CustomShader
operators.summary: Data-driven GLSL generator: renders a project .glsl file (pick it in `file`).

operators.name: Displace
operators.summary: Warp a source texture's sampling by a displacement texture (RG-vector or luminance).

params.description: How the displacement texture drives the offset
params.name: mode

operators.name: Feedback
operators.summary: Frame feedback / trails: blends the input with a decaying history texture.

operators.name: Fold
operators.summary: Crisp axis-aligned mirror reflection of the input — architectural symmetry, not a busy radial kaleidoscope.

operators.name: FreqShift
operators.summary: Bode frequency shifter (Hilbert) with LFO modulation.

operators.name: Gradient
operators.summary: A clean 2-colour linear/radial gradient (a flat source, not a field).

params.description: Linear sweep, or radial from the centre
params.name: mode

operators.name: Image
operators.summary: Load a still image (PNG/JPG/…) from a file into the chain.

operators.name: Instancer
operators.summary: Draws one glowing instance per note of an incoming Notes value (pitch->colour, velocity->size); chords bloom, arps trail.

operators.name: Kaleidoscope
operators.summary: Radial mirror-symmetry (kaleidoscope) fold of the input.

operators.name: LFO
operators.summary: Modulator: a low-frequency oscillator that drives any param through a control wire.

params.name: sync
params.semantic_intent: 0 free-running (rate in Hz), 1 locked to the transport (division in beats)

params.name: rate
params.semantic_intent: oscillation rate in Hz when sync = Free

params.name: division
params.semantic_intent: cycle length in beats when sync = Sync

operators.name: Lines
operators.summary: Real line geometry: a grid / radial burst / concentric rings (wireframe).

operators.name: Mesh
operators.summary: Real 3D geometry: spinning platonic solids (solid flat-lit or wireframe).

operators.name: MeshDisplace
operators.summary: Displace a mesh's vertices by a 2D texture (GPU compute); mesh in + map in, mesh out.

operators.name: MeshLoad
operators.summary: Load a 3D model (glTF/GLB) and output it as a mesh for the geometry pipeline.

operators.name: MeshRender
operators.summary: Render a mesh (from the geometry pipeline) to a textured, lit image.

operators.name: Model
operators.summary: Load a 3D model (glTF/GLB) from a file and render it textured + lit.

operators.name: MovieAudio
operators.summary: Audio track of a Video node's movie, as a graph source (wire through effects).

params.description: Movie-audio bus channel to play (match a Video node's 'audio_bus')
params.name: source

operators.name: NoiseField
operators.summary: Animated 3D FBm noise (Perlin/Simplex/Worley/Value) — a reusable displacement / modulation MAP.

params.description: Zoom level of the noise pattern
params.name: scale

params.description: Rate of animation through the noise Z axis
params.name: speed

params.description: Number of FBm layers; more means finer detail
params.name: octaves

params.description: Algorithm: Perlin, Simplex, Worley, or Value
params.name: noise_type

params.description: Output channels: Mono grayscale, 2 Channel RG, or full RGB
params.name: channels

params.description: Horizontal UV origin the zoom scales about
params.name: scale_from_x

params.description: Vertical UV origin the zoom scales about
params.name: scale_from_y

operators.name: NoiseTexture
operators.summary: 3D FBm noise generator (Perlin/Simplex/Worley/Value) animated over time.

params.description: Zoom level of the noise pattern
params.name: scale

params.description: Rate of animation through the noise Z axis
params.name: speed

params.description: Number of FBm layers; more means finer detail
params.name: octaves

params.description: Algorithm: Perlin, Simplex, Worley, or Value
params.name: noise_type

params.description: Output channels: Mono grayscale, 2 Channel RG, or full RGB
params.name: channels

params.description: Horizontal UV origin the zoom scales about
params.name: scale_from_x

params.description: Vertical UV origin the zoom scales about
params.name: scale_from_y

operators.name: NoteInstancer
operators.summary: One glowing instance per live MIDI note of a track (pitch->colour, velocity->size); chords bloom, arps trail.

operators.name: Notes
operators.summary: A track's live MIDI notes as a value — drives an Instancer (or any note consumer) through an edge.

operators.name: Output
operators.summary: Chain sink: owns the output's size, aspect and fit; feeds the viewer.

operators.name: Plasma
operators.summary: Animated plasma colour-field generator. No input; drives a chain.

operators.name: Reverse
operators.summary: Beat-synced backward playback with crossfaded edges.

operators.name: Rings
operators.summary: Concentric pulsing rings — a source you can drive from the beat.

params.description: how many rings fit across the frame
params.name: count

params.description: brightness — wire this to a kick
params.name: glow

operators.name: Sampler
operators.summary: Plays pitched PCM per note with ADSR + polyphony (melodic or drum-rack).

operators.name: Scratch
operators.summary: DJ-style varispeed scratch with motion patterns.

operators.name: Shape
operators.summary: A crisp SDF shape (circle/polygon) drawn over its input. Geometry, not a field.

params.description: Circle below ~0.15, else a polygon of 3..12 sides
params.name: sides

operators.name: ShapeGrid
operators.summary: A grid of filled polygons drawn as REAL vertex geometry (not a shader field).

operators.name: Shatter
operators.summary: RGB channel-split + blocky glitch displacement — a hard digital shatter, not a haze.

params.description: how many blocks shatter / shove aside
params.name: blocks

operators.name: SpikeSolid
operators.summary: Example loadable .dylib operator: a solid hue-coloured fill.

operators.name: StepBars
operators.summary: Example op with a custom editor: 8 draggable step bars.

operators.name: Stretch
operators.summary: Granular time-stretch (pitch preserved).

operators.name: Stutter
operators.summary: Beat-synced slice repeater with envelope shapes (glitch stutter).

operators.name: SVFilter
operators.summary: State-variable filter (low/high/band-pass) with resonance.

operators.name: Switch
operators.summary: Pass one of four texture inputs through, chosen by index.

params.description: Which input port is passed to the output
params.name: index

operators.name: TapeStop
operators.summary: Tape-deck slowdown/restart (varispeed stop gesture).

operators.name: TestTone
operators.summary: Simple sine instrument (native-instrument spike).

operators.name: Text
operators.summary: Renders a string (from a .txt file) over its input. Typography.

operators.name: Tint
operators.summary: WGSL example generator: a hue-shifted gradient (shows the WGSL authoring path).

operators.name: Transform
operators.summary: Zoom / rotate / translate / tile the input (near-identity at defaults).

params.description: Repeat the image N times across the frame
params.name: tile

operators.name: VectorText
operators.summary: Filled text as REAL vertex geometry (glyph outlines -> triangles).

operators.name: Video
operators.summary: Play a movie file (AVFoundation + HAP) as a source in the chain.

params.description: Movie file to play (mp4/mov/… and HAP-encoded .mov)
params.name: file

params.description: Movie-audio bus channel: add a MovieAudio node with the same 'source' to hear this movie's audio through the audio graph
params.name: audio_bus

operators.name: Webcam
operators.summary: Live camera capture (device / resolution / fps) into the chain.
